requirements.sourceQuote: The prerequisite for admission to the programme is a **relevant Bachelor's degree** in the area of **media and communication studies** **or journalism studies** or another related social science degree programme with proven communication and media science specialisations.
Furthermore, **prior knowledge of empirical methods** is necessary (12 ECTS).
Admission to study in the programme requires the**successful participation in the selection procedure** , which includes a personal interview.
**C1** required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.:

deadlines.dateText: The application period for the winter semester **starts on 1 January and ends 15 July**. All applications are submitted digitally via an [**online application portal**](https://hio.uni-erfurt.de/qisserver/pages/cs/sys/portal/hisinoneStartPage.faces) and will be continually processed. **Early application** is strongly recommended given lengthy visa processes.
